name: First five

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Head: held up now, front and back. It stands on Insurgence's own thick neck straight above the collar, and the chest leans forward only a little. The neck rears back slightly in the roar. Left hand (front): the thin spike above it is gone; the arm now starts at the shoulder plate and turns at the shoulder. Back: the spine runs straight down the middle, and the head is upright over the back. The flame sits beside the horn and stays on the tail's tip as the tail swings. The rest is official Charizard's pose and motion.

note: Eleventh look. Arceus and Christmas Corsoreef are in the library. Delta Charizard is redone: head held up, the left hand fixed, the back straightened.
